# runzero_custom_integration (Resource)

Manages a RunZero custom integration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the custom integration.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the custom integration.
- `icon` (String) Base64-encoded icon for the integration.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the integration was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_by_id` (String) UUID of the user who created the integration.
- `destroyed_at` (String) Timestamp when the integration was destroyed (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the custom integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the integration was last updated (RFC 3339).
